what: Author describes using ChatGPT to generate a prompt, posting it to Notion AI, which created a "fully user-friendly, easy-to-use, polished Notion template" in five minutes. Author used the template personally for 2–3 days before deciding to sell it on Gumroad.
verbatim_snippet: "I posted the freshly copied prompt from ChatGPT to Notion AI. It asked a few questions. All of them were easily answerable (Again, It's easier than you think). Five mins, that's all it needed. (I repeat, all it took was five mins.) After that, I got a fully user-friendly, easy-to-use, polished Notion template beyond my expectations. It had everything I asked for… To be precise, it had gone beyond that. I used it for 2–3 days. I used it myself. That's when I realized Notion's potential — and decided to sell it on Gumroad."
date: Accessed April 2026; page undated in search index (estimated October 2025 from prior search metadata)
notes: 429 rate limit on medium.com; content recovered from Google search index. Author pen name "I'm Someone." Same page describes a two-tool workflow: ChatGPT used to generate a detailed prompt specifying template features (schedule, ideas backlog, priority separation, drafts/published/pending), then Notion AI used to build the template from that prompt. Author states "before selling it on Gumroad, I re-edited it" as the only manual editing step. No sale reported at time of writing. Google search index used as mirror.
